catalogue.name: Space Marines 3.3.6

selectionEntries.name: Chapter

modifiers.value: Chapter is automatically managed by the listbuilder and should appear only once. Remove any extra Chapter entries, then select Ultramarines, Blood Angels, Space Wolves, or Salamanders on the remaining entry.

selectionEntries.comment: CHAPTER CONFIGURATION SCAFFOLD. The PDF requires one of Ultramarines, Blood Angels, Space Wolves, or Salamanders during list building. Ultramarines is the listbuilder's presentation default because it is the first chapter listed in the source; this is not an additional rules statement. Future chapter-specific units should use safe-hide plus constructive wrong-Chapter validation against these stable option IDs.

selectionEntries.name: Additional Copy Costs

modifiers.value: Additional Copy Costs is automatically managed by the listbuilder and should appear only once. Remove any extra Additional Copy Costs entries.

selectionEntries.name: Troops
selectionEntries.comment: REV3 PHASE 1 TROOPS COPY-COST LEDGER. Accounts for all 6 counted non-Rare Troop unit roots in the Space Marines skeleton. Troops use the GS20 4 / 6 / 8 free identical-copy allowance at 800 / 1200 / 1600 Points; each excess identical copy costs +20 Points.

selectionEntries.name: Other
selectionEntries.comment: REV3 PHASE 1 OTHER COPY-COST LEDGER. Accounts for all 48 counted non-Rare Other unit roots in the Space Marines skeleton. Other uses the GS20 1 / 2 / 3 free identical-copy allowance at 800 / 1200 / 1600 Points; each excess identical copy costs +20 Points.

REV3 / GS20 ADDITIONAL COPY COSTS. Permanent required accounting entry. Troops and Other are both fully populated from the Space Marines unit skeleton. Troops use 4 / 6 / 8 free identical copies at 800 / 1200 / 1600 Points; Other uses 1 / 2 / 3. Each excess identical copy costs +20 Points. All six counted Troop roots and all forty-eight counted non-Rare Other roots are included. Leaders are governed by Leader Capacity rather than this ledger.

catalogue.comment:
SPACE MARINES REV1 / GS18 — VEHICLE SCAFFOLD ONLY.
This catalogue is intentionally incomplete. It exists to establish the Space Marine Chapter selector, Chapter presentation semantics, Space Marines Vehicles presentation, stable vehicle unit IDs, source points/type/class metadata, and Additional Copy Costs infrastructure before any vehicle loadouts or rules are implemented. No Infantry, Leader, Troop, chapter-exclusive non-vehicle unit, weapon choice, paid wargear, unit rule, attachment rule, relic, psychic power, or other gameplay payload is implemented in this revision. The army rules PDF remains authoritative.

REV2 — MANUFACTORUM-READY VEHICLE SCAFFOLD
Aligned native vehicle presentation with the established Astra Militarum / Manufactorum bridge pattern. All eleven native Space Marine vehicle shells now present under Other while retaining their existing Space Marines Vehicles category links as non-primary compatibility tags. The ten chapter-independent vehicle shells are mirrored into Manufactorum Imperium V6 using the same unit IDs. Baal Predator remains local to Space Marines / Blood Angels and is not exported through Manufactorum.

REV3 / GS20 — PHASE 1 COMPLETE EMPTY UNIT SHELLS
Updated the catalogue to Space Marines 3.3.6 and Game System revision 20. The supplied Unit Skeleton file is treated as mechanically identical to the 3.3.6 PDF per the author; the PDF was not used for this pass. All 71 unit roots are now present in skeleton order with unit type, unit class, Chapter gating, counted/copy semantics, base Points, Leader attachment relationships, and host attachment-capacity validation. All 17 Leaders count toward Leader Capacity; all 6 Troops participate in the GS20 Troop Additional Copy Costs ledger; all 48 Other units participate in the GS20 Other Additional Copy Costs ledger. There are no Rare, Monster, or Countless units in the supplied skeleton. The eleven established vehicle IDs and Space Marines Vehicles bridge category-link IDs are preserved for Manufactorum compatibility. Internal loadouts, paid wargear, model cards, characteristics profiles, rules payloads, and Additional Model selections remain intentionally unimplemented for the next phases. The skeleton contains 4 reciprocal attachment metadata mismatches involving Assault Intercessors and Jump Pack Leaders; REV3 compiles eligibility from the attaching-Leader allowed_units lists, which are the operative association source.
